in_sanskrit.name: Ryanraj
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Little King, Prince
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ryanraj एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Ryan is a modern name, Raj is a Sanskrit or Hindu name meaning 'king' or 'ruler'. Ryanraj is a combination of these two names, and means 'Little King' or 'Prince'.

in_hindi.name: रायनराज
in_hindi.long_meaning: राजा (rājā) means 'ruler, king, or rule'. रायन (rāyan) is an English name of Irish origin, which means 'little king'. So, रायनराज (rāyanrāj) can be translated as 'little king, ruler, or rule'.

in_tamil.name: ரயன்ராஜ்
in_tamil.long_meaning: ராஜா (rājā) means 'ruler, king, or rule'. ரயன் (rayaṉ) is an English name of Irish origin, which means 'little king'. So, ரயன்ராஜ் (rayaṉrāj) can be translated as 'little king, ruler, or rule'.

in_telugu.name: రాయన్రాజ్
in_telugu.long_meaning: రాజేశ్వర్ (rājēśvar) means 'ruler of the kings, king of kings'. రాయన్ (rāyan) is an English name of Irish origin, which means 'little king'. So, రాయన్రాజ్ (rāyanrāj) can be translated as 'little king, ruler, or king of kings'.
